facts.fact: The Great Place to Work 2023 Best Workplaces in Canada score is 75% based on confidential employee feedback from the Trust Index Survey.
facts.quote: Seventy five percent of each organization’s score is based on confidential employee feedback, from the globally recognized Trust Index® Survey.

facts.fact: The Great Place to Work 2023 Best Workplaces in Canada score assigns the remaining 25% to the quality, quantity, and effectiveness of programs and policies supporting employees and culture.
facts.quote: The remaining 25% is based on quality, quantity, and effectiveness of the programs and policies which support their employees and corporate culture.

facts.fact: The 2023 Best Workplaces in Canada list captures the experience and sentiment of 150,000 employees, according to Great Place to Work.
facts.quote: This year’s 2023 Best Workplaces™ in Canada list captures the experience and sentiment of 150,000 employees

facts.fact: The 2023 Best Workplaces in Canada list is expected to impact over 500,000 Canadian employees.
facts.quote: rolling out to impact over 500,000 Canadian employees.

facts.fact: Great Place to Work's global survey represents the voices of 11 million employees, which are the primary determinant used in selecting winners.
facts.quote: Globally, this survey represents the voices of 11 million employees, which are the primary determinant used in selecting winners.

facts.fact: Great Place to Work's world's largest annual workplace study culminates in national lists in over 50 countries.
facts.quote: which culminates in a series of national lists in over 50 countries

facts.fact: StackAdapt is used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world, per its own description.
facts.quote: a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
